item.title: Free Will and Predetermination
item.description:
Free Will and Predetermination Alan Adams Jacobs

Source: TW

Author: Alan Adams Jacobs

_The following essay was included in ‘Self Enquiry’ December 1999 (Published by theRamana Maharshi Foundation UK). It is written in the form of a Socratic Dialogue by Alan Adams Jacobs, the chairman of the RMF UK. _

SOCRATES Hail to Thee, Aeschines! From where do you return to visit us now?

AESCHINES I have just returned from my father’s kitchen where I was assisting him in making his famed spiced meat delicacies.
